# DevHub Toolkit

> 56 fast, keyboard-first developer utilities — formatters, encoders, generators, AI helpers, and references — in one clean interface.

DevHub Toolkit is a browser-based developer productivity platform. All non-AI tools run client-side with no tracking. AI tools call Google Gemini via a server endpoint.

Full, machine-readable index (all tools, SEO titles, descriptions, keywords, categories, changelog):
https://devhub.flinkeo.online/llms-full.txt

## Pages

- [Home](https://devhub.flinkeo.online/): Browse and search all tools.
- [All Tools](https://devhub.flinkeo.online/tools): Filterable grid of every tool.
- [Changelog](https://devhub.flinkeo.online/changelog): Recent updates.
- [Favorites](https://devhub.flinkeo.online/favorites): Your saved tools.
